scope.core: Read a central business JSON profile, dynamically inject corresponding theme custom properties and content structures, compile individual client configurations, and pass build checks without hardcoded brand artifacts.
scope.out: No database, no persistence, no real email sending, no payment processing, no user accounts beyond admin password.
stack.frontend: Next.js 14 (Pages Router), Vanilla dependency-free CSS with CSS Modules and semantic custom properties, zero external design component libraries.
stack.backend: Next.js API Routes (pages/api/), portable to Vercel Edge and Cloudflare Pages Workers.
auth.model: Admin password validated via secure environment HMAC tokens (sessionStorage client-side, server-side HMAC verification).
deployment: Cloudflare Pages with Workers / Vercel Edge Architecture, static export capable.
quality.acceptance: 100% production build pass condition, zero lingering hardcoded brand references, automated schema validation on the runtime configuration profile, error/empty/loading states on all interactive surfaces.
